newsitem.title: BERMUDA: BERMUDA BOURSE APPROVES COSSACK BOND LISTING.
newsitem.headline: BERMUDA BOURSE APPROVES COSSACK BOND LISTING.

text.p: The Bermuda Stock Exchange (BSX) said Thursday it had approved the listing of GFM Cossack Bond Co Ltd. (CBC).
Incorporated in the Cayman Islands as an open-ended investment company, CBC invests in debt and fixed-income obligations of the governments and agencies of the Commonwealth of Independent States.
Subscriptions are limited to qualified investors and may not be traded in lots with an initial value of less than US$100,000.

"The listing of CBC represents the growing number of emerging market instruments that have chosen the BSX as their listing venue of choice," BSX chief operating officer Greg Wojciechowski said in a statement. "The latest listing complements our rapidly growing mutual fund sector."

CBC's investment manager is GFM Russian Management Co Ltd, incoporated in the British Virgin Islands. It specializes in investment and fund management in fixed-income markets, particularly in Eastern Europe and the CIS.
